  merged = []
  i = 0  # Index for left array
  j = 0  # Index for right array

  while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
    if left[i] <= right[j]:
      merged.append(left[i])
      i += 1
    else:
      merged.append(right[j])
      j += 1

  # Add any remaining elements from left or right
  merged.extend(left[i:])
  merged.extend(right[j:])

  return merged

  This function merges two lists into a single sorted list.

  Args:

    right: The second list.

    A new list containing the sorted elements from left and right.
  """

  merged = []
  i = 0
  j = 0

  while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
    if left[i] <= right[j]:
      merged.append(left[i])
      i += 1
    else:
      merged.append(right[j])
      j += 1

  # Add any remaining elements from left or right
  while i < len(left):
    merged.append(left[i])
    i += 1
  while j < len(right):
    merged.append(right[j])
    j += 1

  return merged
